info.name: cPanel Mail Sync
info.summary: Synchronize Nextcloud users with cPanel email accounts. The app developed by Salman Yahya from Vitechcloud
info.description: Automatically create and delete cPanel email accounts when Nextcloud users are created or removed. Features: - Auto-create cPanel email on Nextcloud user creation - Prompt to delete email when Nextcloud user is deleted - Admin sync panel showing all email accounts - Full cPanel UAPI integration
info.author: Your Organization
